children: AEVEX Corp. (NYSE: AVEX), a leading U.S. defense technology company delivering autonomous unmanned systems, AI-enabled mission software, and advanced ISR and EW solutions, today announced expansions of its corporate footprint in Florida and Virginia to meet growing production demand and to enhance collaboration with U.S. government customers and industry partners.
The investments expand AEVEX’s manufacturing capacity and customer-facing infrastructure to support AEVEX’s rapid scaling and to meet increasing demand for battle-proven autonomous systems.

“Customers are increasingly looking for proven autonomous systems that can be delivered at scale and on shorter operational timelines,” said Roger Wells, Chief Executive Officer of AEVEX. “We are investing to stay ahead of that demand – expanding our production capacity, putting our teams closer to the customer, and building the infrastructure needed to execute as the market continues to grow.”
Florida expansion boosts production capacity and strengthens strategic footprint

In Florida, AEVEX is significantly expanding and consolidating its Tampa manufacturing operations to support rising production requirements and establish additional capacity for future growth. The investment is expected to more than double production capacity over the next year while providing greater operational flexibility to respond to customer demand. Tampa’s position within a major U.S. defense and national security hub enhances AEVEX’s proximity to key customers, partners, and mission stakeholders.

The new footprint will include a large-scale ecosystem designed for high-volume production, dedicated space for AEVEX’s expanding additive manufacturing and Uncrewed Surface Vehicle (USV) operations, and increased capacity for manufacturing, engineering, technical, and program personnel.

“Scaling production is about more than just adding space – it is about creating the operational capacity and customer proximity to move quickly as mission requirements evolve,” said Murali Krishnan, Chief Growth Officer at AEVEX. “The Tampa expansion gives us greater flexibility to increase throughput, work closely with customers, and deliver mission-ready systems at the speed and volume they require.”
Virginia office strengthens customer proximity and mission collaboration

AEVEX has also secured new dedicated office space in Arlington, Virginia, establishing an expanded hub for close collaboration with U.S. government customers, defense partners, and other national security stakeholders. The location will support teams working across unmanned systems programs, autonomy integration, engineering, program execution, and customer engagement, enabling tighter coordination as mission requirements evolve and new programs move from development to fielding.

“Proximity to the customer is critical to how we operate,” said Krishnan. “The Virginia office will allow our teams to collaborate more closely with customers, better understand evolving mission requirements, and move quickly to deliver the capabilities they need.”
Investing to support AEVEX’s long-term growth

The Florida and Virginia investments form part of AEVEX’s broader strategy to increase manufacturing throughput and build the infrastructure required to support continued growth across its autonomous systems business.

AEVEX Corp. (NYSE: AVEX) is a leading U.S. defense technology company delivering autonomous unmanned systems, AI-enabled mission software, and advanced ISR and electronic warfare solutions for national security customers. With vertically integrated engineering, rapid prototyping, and high-volume manufacturing across multiple U.S. locations, AEVEX provides affordable, front-line-ready capabilities designed for contested and GPS-denied environments. AEVEX’s mission is to strengthen deterrence, enhance warfighter effectiveness, and help ensure the United States maintains technological and industrial advantage in the era of autonomy.
